title: Commit Checkpoint Signals
description: Contract for the mid-AC commit checkpoint in /work Step 3 (#2557). The checkpoint fires DURING an acceptance criterion, independent of the commit-per-deliverable gate, which only has a trigger at AC boundaries.

appliesTo.description: Run shapes the checkpoint applies to. MUST include 'standard': the motivating incident was a standard single-issue /work run, which nonstop-audit.js does not cover.

blocking.description: Always false. Per 06-runtime-triggers.md 'offer, don't force' — a hard gate mid-investigation would interrupt exactly the flow it protects.

measurement.description: The mechanical source of the signal. Must be something /work can already run — the checkpoint adds no new instrumentation.

combinator.description: 'any' = either threshold crossing arms the prompt.

rationale.description: Why this number. Required: these values ship to every project, so a future tuner needs the reasoning, not just the digit.

namesMilestone.description: Always true. The delta decides when to ask; the answer supplies what the commit message says. A trigger without the naming half leaves the bad-attribution half of the incident unaddressed.

distinctFromNonstopAudit.description: Why this threshold and nonstop-audit.js audit (1) differ. Recorded rather than reconciled: they measure incompatible units (#2557 AC5).

reconcilable.description: Always false. Volume-within-an-AC and commits-per-AC are different units; no single number satisfies both.
